=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4000-4004 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The sweep's newly-introduced managed-status check uses `grep -qF "Managed by: AI Orchestrator"` which matches the marker string anywhere in the issue body — including mid-sentence prose, not just on a metadata line. A standalone issue (no `ai:orchestrator-managed` label) whose body merely quotes or mentions the text is treated as orchestrator-managed, bypassing the target-branch gate at line 4042. Any merged PR into any branch would then close that issue, defeating the entire #4813 fix for that issue.
  WHY: The `grep -qF` does a fixed-string substring search with no anchor or line-start requirement. Issue #4957's own body quotes this marker in prose — that is the exact spoof shape the security audit flagged. An `ai:merged` or `ai:ready-to-merge` labelled issue (labels applied by automation) whose body contains the prose mention would be closed by a PR merged into any non-default, non-integration branch.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:4002
  Issue: The body-text managed-status check allows prose mentions to spoof orchestrator-managed status, bypassing the target-branch gate. Issue #4957 tracks the full label-only fix; until that lands, narrowing the body match from "anywhere in the body" to "a line starting with the marker" would reduce the spoof surface.
  Suggested minimal fix: Replace `grep -qF` with a line-anchored match: `printf '%s' "${_sweep_issue_body}" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*-?[[:space:]]*Managed by: AI Orchestrator[[:space:]]*$'`
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
